description: Renders a document comparison as TEXT aligned by BLOCK (redesign 146c7e1b, phase 7, DE-2.6, decision DE3): a header with the title, the 'N changes found (a added, r removed, c changed)' sentence, a legend (Added / Removed / Changed), a DiffViewMode switch and next / previous change navigation, two column heads (OldTitle / OldMeta, NewTitle / NewMeta) and one grid row per block - the removed side left, the added side right, a changed block tinted on both sides - or, in Unified mode, one column. It computes the comparison itself from two documents (DocumentComparisonService) or takes a precomputed DocumentCompareResult. There is no formatted preview and the engine never draws the two documents. With OnBack it shows 'Back to document'.

parameters.name: NewTitle
parameters.description: Optional title for the new side.

parameters.name: OldTitle
parameters.description: Optional title for the old side.

parameters.name: SideBySide
parameters.description: Whether side-by-side text panes should be shown.

parameters.name: InitialBlockId
parameters.description: Id of a block whose row is selected (and brought into view) when the viewer first shows it.

parameters.name: NewMeta
parameters.description: Optional one-line description of the new side.

parameters.name: OldMeta
parameters.description: Optional one-line description of the old side, for example "Version 1.0 - 12 Apr 2024 14:32 - Jan Prochazka".

parameters.name: OnBack
parameters.description: When bound, a "Back to document" button is shown in the header and raises this callback.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Optional heading of the viewer. Blank shows the localized "Version comparison".

parameters.name: ViewMode
parameters.description: How the two sides are laid out: SideBySide (default) or Unified. The viewer keeps its own copy once the reader switches; a new parameter value from the host wins again.

parameters.name: ViewModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the reader switches the view mode with the built-in selector.

parameters.name: Compact
parameters.description: The phone presentation (decision G2): the view starts as Unified (unless ViewMode is set) and the side-by-side selector gives way to a three-segment switch - Older, Newer, Differences - that shows one text at a time. Defaults to false (the full viewer).
